'''Silik lizards''' were rare [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] native to the [[Silent Desert]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. They were silicon-based life forms that were able to absorb energy from the sand.<ref name="DOTJ0" />

==Biology and appearance==
Silik lizards were around size of [[Human/Legends|Human]] adults and had silicon-based skin with spines on their bodies. With the ability to stand up on their back legs, this six-limbed lizard was a formidable foe which was prized as a hunting trophy.<ref name="DOTJ0" />

==Hunting==
Although silik lizards could absorb energy from the sand to sustain themselves and produce sparks, they would also [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[mammal]]s and eat their spinal fluid to supplement their diets. Before attacking, they would let out a scream that was silent in the [[Silent Desert]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. They hunted at night. <ref name="DOTJ0" />
